learned_patterns.name: Build one merged, signed 4.7.1 assembly for both cloud and on-premise
learned_patterns.context: Plugin assembly targeting for D365 9.x on-prem and Dataverse cloud
learned_patterns.pattern: Set TargetFrameworkVersion=v4.7.1 with a FrameworkPathOverride onto the NuGet reference assemblies, ILMerge the dependencies, sign with the .snk, and ship the dist output. Cloud enforces the 4.7.1 ceiling and on-prem accepts it, so a single artifact serves both.

learned_patterns.name: Generate the solution manifest from build output
learned_patterns.context: Packaging web resources into a hand-built solution ZIP
learned_patterns.pattern: Walk the dist directory at package time and emit RootComponents plus customizations.xml entries with deterministic md5-derived GUIDs. Never maintain the list by hand.

learned_patterns.name: try/catch-degrade every optional metadata read
learned_patterns.context: Reading schema that may not be provisioned in a given org
learned_patterns.pattern: Each optional table read gets its own try/catch that degrades to absent. The same binary then works before and after provisioning, so a stakeholder gate stays a data decision rather than a code branch.

common_mistakes.mistake: Registering the thin bin/Release assembly instead of the merged, signed dist assembly
common_mistakes.symptom: FileNotFoundException on an external reference (Newtonsoft 13.0.0.0) at plugin runtime
common_mistakes.prevention: Register from dist/ only. Changing the signing token requires unregister + re-register; Update is refused.

common_mistakes.mistake: Reading lookups with the OData _<attr>_value form inside a plugin
common_mistakes.symptom: Lookup reads null in the plugin while the equivalent Web API client works
common_mistakes.prevention: Plugins use the SDK logical lookup name and EntityReference. The _value form is Web API only.

common_mistakes.mistake: Rebuilding a model field-by-field and silently dropping properties
common_mistakes.symptom: SecurityStripper.Strip dropped Design and the scoped tab/section Buttons. Latent for weeks — the cloud live-metadata path masked it, and the in-CRM engine reads the cache, so buttons and design never appeared in CRM while every test passed.
common_mistakes.prevention: Any transform that reconstructs a domain model needs a test asserting field parity against the source model, not just the fields the transform is nominally about.
common_mistakes.cost: weeks latent, found only by live-org inspection

common_mistakes.mistake: Judging a plugin deployment by its first invocation
common_mistakes.symptom: Fix appears not to work; the sandbox served the previous AppDomain
common_mistakes.prevention: Wait 30-60s and re-run once before concluding anything.

common_mistakes.mistake: Matching a version field exactly when the contract says 0 means latest
common_mistakes.symptom: FindActiveCache matched qdb_published_version exactly, so the documented 'version 0 = latest active' never matched and every form load failed.
common_mistakes.prevention: When a sentinel value is documented, assert it in a test. Sentinels are contract, not convention.

preferred_approaches.approach: Async handoff to a queue or job record. Constitution Article X — the sandbox has a two-minute hard limit and no outbound network calls.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Synchronous work that grows past the limit fails in production under load rather than in test.

preferred_approaches.approach: Deploy, wait, re-run once, then read the actual record or cache entry the runtime consumes.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Test-suite green has repeatedly coexisted with a broken CRM path — see CRM-M-003.
